# Will a seasonal ice cream shop pay its loan, and which months should stay closed?

> Free ice cream shop profit calculator: twelve months of days open and customers per day become monthly profit, break-even customers, open-or-close verdicts, loan coverage and the cash reserve the slow months need. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ice-cream-shop-seasonal-profit-calculator/)
